column1: # Curated, growing list of "we know for a fact rocThrust already contains
# this specific upstream fix" fingerprints. Each row maps a fixed-string
# code pattern to the CCCL tag it was introduced in. cccl-version-delta.sh
# greps rocThrust's local tree for each pattern (no network/remote needed)
# and reports the highest tag whose fingerprint is already present — this
# is Signal C, a local-only corroborating/contradicting check against
# Add a new row whenever a human (or this skill) discovers rocThrust's tree
# already contains a fingerprinted upstream fix ahead of what Signals A/B
# reported — this is exactly how the first row below was discovered.
# Format: tab-separated, comments start with '#', blank lines ignored.
